summary: Frontend-only testing of Cognitive Updating Windows 95 CBT restyle. All critical flows verified: menu->instructions->test transition, both MFDI columns (6 tabs each) independently switchable, simultaneous different tabs, both columns showing same tab (Message), pump ON raises pressure (91->100), continuous fuel drain when Engine hidden (434->428), comms code entry with green LED on correct 3-digit match, parcel workflow (select lat/lon/time + digits + prepare + release = DROPPED), 30s auto-end reaching results screen with 7 metrics + OVERALL SCORE. Percentage clamp fix confirmed - all 3 time-in-range values stayed <=100.0% (36.8%, 83.6%, 100.0%). Dashboard shows 2 READY (Cognitive Updating, System Logic) + 10 LOCKED. Admin settings save/reload persistence verified. System Logic module loads successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: CognitiveUpdating.js is 884 lines - consider splitting sub-panels (SystemPanel, MissionPanel, MessagePanel, EnginePanel, NavigationPanel, SensorPanel, MFDI) into separate files under /modules/CognitiveUpdating/ for maintainability.
Score clamp Math.min(100, ...) correctly applied to pressure/fuel/speed scores at line 251-253; regression from iteration 3 preserved.

Sensor/camera activation not tested end-to-end in this run (timing-sensitive within 30s); results showed 0/2 for both which is acceptable since script did not exercise them at their target seconds - functionality preserved from prior iterations.
seed_data_creation: Set cu-easy-duration=30 via /admin for quick full-workflow verification.

Old upper-tab-*/lower-tab-* are gone. Comms code test verified correct green LED. Results screen scoring clamp verified - no percentage exceeded 100.0%.
